WITH dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk AS d_date_sk,
           d_date AS d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
store_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT (c.c_last_name IS NULL) AS last_name_is_null,
           COALESCE(c.c_last_name, '') AS last_name_value,
           (c.c_first_name IS NULL) AS first_name_is_null,
           COALESCE(c.c_first_name, '') AS first_name_value,
           dates.d_date AS d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN dates ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY (c.c_last_name IS NULL),
             COALESCE(c.c_last_name, ''),
             (c.c_first_name IS NULL),
             COALESCE(c.c_first_name, ''),
             dates.d_date
),
catalog_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT (c.c_last_name IS NULL) AS last_name_is_null,
           COALESCE(c.c_last_name, '') AS last_name_value,
           (c.c_first_name IS NULL) AS first_name_is_null,
           COALESCE(c.c_first_name, '') AS first_name_value,
           dates.d_date AS d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN dates ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY (c.c_last_name IS NULL),
             COALESCE(c.c_last_name, ''),
             (c.c_first_name IS NULL),
             COALESCE(c.c_first_name, ''),
             dates.d_date
),
web_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT (c.c_last_name IS NULL) AS last_name_is_null,
           COALESCE(c.c_last_name, '') AS last_name_value,
           (c.c_first_name IS NULL) AS first_name_is_null,
           COALESCE(c.c_first_name, '') AS first_name_value,
           dates.d_date AS d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN dates ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = dates.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer c ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY (c.c_last_name IS NULL),
             COALESCE(c.c_last_name, ''),
             (c.c_first_name IS NULL),
             COALESCE(c.c_first_name, ''),
             dates.d_date
)
SELECT count(*)
FROM store_names s
JOIN catalog_names ca
  ON s.last_name_is_null = ca.last_name_is_null
 AND s.last_name_value = ca.last_name_value
 AND s.first_name_is_null = ca.first_name_is_null
 AND s.first_name_value = ca.first_name_value
 AND s.d_date = ca.d_date
JOIN web_names w
  ON s.last_name_is_null = w.last_name_is_null
 AND s.last_name_value = w.last_name_value
 AND s.first_name_is_null = w.first_name_is_null
 AND s.first_name_value = w.first_name_value
 AND s.d_date = w.d_date
LIMIT 100
